1.text: Zaburi ya Salomo.Uhe umwami guca imanza kwawe,Uhe umwana w'umwami kutabera kwawe.

2.text: Azacira abantu bawe imanza zitabera,N'abanyamubabaro bawe azabacira imanza z'ukuri.

3.text: Guca imanza zitabera kuzatuma imisozi miremireN'imigufi izanira abantu amahoro.

4.text: Azaca imanza zirengera abanyamubabaro bo mu bantu,Azakiza abana b'abakene,Kandi azavunagura umunyagahato.

6.text: Azamera nk'imvura imanuka ikanyagira ibyatsi biciwe,Nk'ibitonyanga bitonyangira ubutaka.

7.text: Mu minsi ye abakiranutsi bazashisha,Kandi hazabaho amahoro menshi,Kugeza aho ukwezi kuzashirira.

8.text: Azatwara ahereye ku nyanja ageze ku yindi nyanja,Kandi ahereye kuri rwa Ruzi ageze ku mpera y'isi.

9.text: Ababa mu butayu bazamwunamira,Abanzi be bazarigata umukungugu.

10.text: Abami b'i Tarushishi n'abami bo ku birwa bazazana amaturo,Abami b'i Sheba n'abami b'i Seba bazazana ikoro.

11.text: Abami bose bazamwikubita imbere,Amahanga yose azamukorera.

12.text: Kuko azakiza umukene ubwo azataka,N'umunyamubabaro utagira gitabara.

14.text: Azacungura ubugingo bwabo,Abukize agahato n'urugomo,Kandi amaraso yabo azaba ay'igiciro cyinshi imbere ye.

15.text: Nuko azarama kandi bazamuha ku izahabu y'i Sheba,Bazamusabira iteka,Bazamusabira umugisha umunsi wire.

16.text: Hazabaho amasaka menshi mu gihugu no mu mpinga z'imisozi,Amahundo yayo azanyeganyega nk'ibiti byo kuri Lebanoni,Abanyamudugudu bazashisha nk'ubwatsi bwo ku butaka burabije.

17.text: Izina rye rizahoraho iteka ryose,Izina rye rizahamaho, izuba rikiriho,Abantu bazisabira umugisha wo guhwana na we,Amahanga yose azamwita umunyehirwe.

18.text: Uwiteka Imana ni yo Mana y'Abisirayeli ihimbazwe,Ni yo yonyine ikora ibitangaza.

19.text: Izina ryayo ry'icyubahiro rihimbazwe iteka,Isi yose yuzure icyubahiro cyayo.Amen kandi Amen.

20.text: Ibyo Dawidi mwene Yesayi yasabye birarangiye.
